page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Bluemarine?

Mrs. Bluemarine is the "adopted" mother of Domenico Pucci, who she abducted as an infant and renamed after her deceased son .

Mrs. Bluemarine is an adult woman of slim build, with multiple hair buns tied on each side of her head.

Mrs. Bluemarine appeared to be depressed and unsatisfied with the direction of her life, seeing the child she gave birth to as a sign of hope. After the child died she rashly swapped his body with one of the newborn Pucci twins and raised him as her own. However she seemed to feel genuine remorse for his original family and claimed to Enrico Pucci she genuinely attempted to raise the child with love to the best of her ability.

Mrs. Bluemarine appeared to have had a hard and unhappy life even after getting married in 1972. On June 5th of the same year, she believed her newborn would represent hope for a brighter future but he died shortly after his birth. Unwilling to accept this, she snuck into one of the clinic rooms and swapped her deceased son with one of the twin babies of the Pucci family , while the doctors were busy going on to raise him as her own naming him "Wes Bluemarine". 16 years later in 1988 she came down with a terminal illness and confessed to her local soon to be priest(who unbeknownst to her was the older twin brother of the baby she took), about her sin in 1972 in order to ease her consciousness. After Pucci deduced that "Wes" was really his younger brother and found out he was beginning to unknowingly date their younger sister, he hired a "private detective agency" to split them up. The detective however found out that the man Mrs. Bluemarine married in 1972 was African American and assumed her son must be a mixed race child, deciding to rally the at her house. Ultimately the detective had Wes lynched and had burned down his house while Mrs. Bluemarine was inside.
